values.note: Standard sites $30, the 18 premium lakefront sites and the full-hookup site $34; double sites $60-68.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232665/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-12..2026-09-07 and 2027-03-11..2027-09-06: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, premium STANDARD ELECTRIC 34, RV ELECTRIC 34, doubles 60/68) + fee description ('Campsite fees range from $22-$64 per night'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232665 (all 45 RV sites 'Electricity Hookup 50', 'Water Hookup Y'; sewer on site 59 only), read 2026-10-30

values.note: recreation.gov sells 56: 45 RV sites (Max Vehicle Length 20-58 ft; 43 take a 23-ft rig, sites 13 and 14 are 20-21 ft; 8 pull-throughs; three doubles) and 11 tent-only. 18 sites lakefront.

sites.source: recreation.gov description ('Payne Campground provides 57 spacious reservable campsites') + campsite search (44 STANDARD ELECTRIC + 1 RV ELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 20..58, Driveway Entry Pull-through x8; 11 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; Proximity to Water 'Lakefront' x18), read 2026-10-30

facilities.source: recreation.gov description ('Fire rings, picnic areas, drinking water, flush toilets and showers are all provided'; 'conveniently located near the dock and swimming beach'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on holiday weekends; 14 nights in any 30 at Allatoona Corps campgrounds; same-day booking allowed. Check-in 4 pm, check-out 11 am. Entrance gate closed 10:30 pm - 7 am.

booking.source: recreation.gov facility_rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0) + notices ('Camping limit is 14 consecutive days or 14 non-consecutive days in any 30-day period'; 'Entrance gate is closed from 10:30 p.m. to 7 a.m.') + site attributes (Checkin Time 4:00 PM, Checkout Time 11:00 AM), read 2026-10-30

summary: rec.gov confirms $30-34 (fees manual, checked 2027; doubles $60-68 in fees.note), 50-amp + water (now manual), 57 sites (56 sold; 43 of 45 RV sites take 23 ft, max 58, 8 pull-throughs), flush toilets/showers/water, reservable on rec.gov with 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums and 14 in 30. Season left unset. AWH note kept verbatim (its 18 waterfront sites match rec.gov's 18 'Lakefront').
flags: PIN ~290 m from the RV-site centroid: stored 34.1226,-84.6210; suggest 34.1203,-84.6195 (centroid of 45 rec.gov RV sites).
